timing_scope: MuSc.make_category_data entry through synchronized pre-metric predictions; includes loading, decoding, preprocessing, transfers, encoding, aggregation, scoring, interpolation, RsCIN and first-use compilation; excludes imports, model loading, metric evaluation and artifact serialization
